items.title: Reports describe wider missile attack on Kyiv and disruption to electricity
items.summary: Reports say Russia launched several waves of ballistic and other missiles toward Kyiv, with strikes and fires reported near several major bridges. Some Ukrainian air-defence interceptions were also reported, while parts of the capital reportedly experienced electricity disruptions. The extent of damage and casualties was not established.

items.title: Russian Geran drones reportedly strike targets in western Ukraine
items.summary: Reports say around 20 jet-powered Geran drones struck alleged Ukrainian military targets in western regions during the wider overnight attack. The specific locations, targets and damage were not detailed.

items.title: US reportedly discusses possible Ukrainian NATO membership in talks
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal was cited as reporting that the United States discussed potential NATO membership for Ukraine during recent negotiations. The report did not indicate a formal invitation or an agreed accession timetable.
